hook: An MR contrast agent stays dark until inflamed, scarring tissue switches it on within minutes.
hook_turn: until inflamed, scarring tissue switches it on within minutes.
summary: The iron-based probe gives almost no MRI signal until oxidation in inflamed tissue turns it on, and it then binds remodeled scar matrix, which boosts and holds the signal. In mouse models of kidney and liver fibrosis it produced disease-linked contrast within minutes of injection. It has been tested only in mice, so human safety and performance are unknown.
title: Magnetic Resonance Silent Activatable Probe with Massive Signal Amplification for Rapid Detection of Inflammation-Associated Fibrogenesis
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
